KO/EN/DE: original public briefing and equal-peer objection, distinct pilot contexts and 80/120 versus 60/95 counts. Shared table, repeats versus unique people, convenience versus concurrent intervention, acknowledged delay objection and conditional pilot, cost/employment explicitly out of scope. Regret and cautious self-review distinct from forecast/guilt; arrival-triggered follow-up not completed. Seven required contrasts.

KO/EN/DE: actual original news report and separate multi-paragraph opinion essay. Same period length/count method with repeats and unknown unique users; concurrent education/campaign prevents single-cause proof. Last in-person option lost but online remains; conditional not-even-apply warning not a universal observed count. Clear concession, alternative explanations, conditional recommendation and unmeasured costs/employment.

KO/EN/DE: required complete free opinion essay with source citations, two arguments, strongest objection, concession/response and limited conclusion. Distinguish counts/people and alternatives, purpose/outcome, scalar emphasis and missing data. Compare sources and revise overclaim; semantic and argumentation quality unscored.

KO/EN/DE: formal public briefing, polite equal-peer response to benefits-delay objection without denial of observed increase or personal blame, two interpretations and access criterion. Personal regret versus cautious question, then formal bounded conclusion/follow-up; replay argument/concession/conclusion pauses and focus. Meaning and intonation unscored.
